title: The system pullback compositor respects tensor for two composable maps
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, Operations o and Compositors c [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. For composable scheme maps f:X to Y and g:Y to Z and arbitrary A,B in System(Z), the following two maps agree. The first applies c.pullComp(f,g) to A tensor B, then pulls back the tensor comparison for g along f and applies the tensor comparison for f. The second applies the fixed tensor comparison for f followed by g, then tensors c.pullComp(f,g) on A and B. The tensor comparisons and tensors are those of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. This is an equality in the whole derived system category; it involves only two composable maps, with no square or proper/open transformation.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument, as recorded in lem-sf-integral-canonical-ambient-models.

proof.text: Use the proved cochain composition equation integralSystemTensorCochainComposition: the ordinary compositor on the total tensor intertwines the two successive unit-normalized tensor comparisons and the composite-map comparison. Its companion module proves this by adjunction-unit conjugation and total-summand pure generators.

Invert the cochain compositor and the derived compositor model equations by cancellation of the corresponding isomorphisms. For K-flat P and Q, paste the three specified pullbackTensorSystemComparison normalization squares, naturality of the exact-derived factorization, naturality of the system tensor model, and the localized cochain equality. The generic diagram_paste calculation from ScalarHomTensorCoherence performs this categorical pasting. Cancel the source and target representative isomorphisms. This proves composition_on_representatives.

Every derived system is isomorphic to the localization of a K-flat complex: take a complex preimage and a K-flat resolution, and invert its quasi-isomorphism. Form the two natural transformations for the inverse-compositor version of the tensor equation. Their components coincide on K-flat pairs by composition_on_representatives, so naturality along a pair of representative isomorphisms identifies them everywhere. Precompose by the forward compositor and postcompose by its tensor to obtain the statement in its original direction.

theorem integralSystemTensorComposition (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (A B : System l E Z) :
    (c.pullComp f g).hom.app ((calculus l E Z).systemClosed.tensor.obj (A, B)) ≫
        (pull l E f).map ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E g).hom.app (A, B)) ≫
        (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
          ((pull l E g).obj A, (pull l E g).obj B) =
      (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E (f ≫ g)).hom.app (A, B) ≫
        (calculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom ((c.pullComp f g).hom.app A) ((c.pullComp f g).hom.app B))
